components.label: Composition
components.quote: Yellow fever virus1 17D-204 strain (live, attenuated) .................................... not less than 1000 IU

components.label: Composition
components.quote: produced in specified pathogen-free chick embryos

components.label: Excipients with known effects
components.quote: This product contains approximately 8 mg of sorbitol (E420) per dose.

components.label: Nature and contents of container
components.quote:
Powder in vial (type I glass), with a stopper (chlorobutyl) and a flip-off cap
      (aluminium) + 0.5 ml of solvent in a pre-filled syringe (type I glass), with a
      plunger-stopper (halobutyl), and an attached needle and needle-shield (natural
      rubber or polyisoprene) – pack size of 1, 10 or 20.

allergens.quote:
Hypersensitivity to the active substance or to any of the excipients listed in Section
      6.1 or to eggs or chicken proteins.

The tip caps of the prefilled syringes contain a natural rubber latex derivative,
      which may cause allergic reactions in latex sensitive individuals.
